risks.description: Daily OPD flow could be disturbed by new queue software at live counters.
risks.mitigation: Phased rollout per counter group; rollback plan; pilot runs in parallel with manual fallback registration.

risks.description: Patient registration timestamps are personal data under DPDP rules.
risks.mitigation: Sampling extracts are de-identified; only aggregate wait times leave the hospital; access logged.

risks.description: A third-party system connects to hospital network services.
risks.mitigation: Sandboxed environment, no production data writes, vendor audit, and connectivity only to the reporting API.

risks.description: A software fault must never block a patient from being registered.
risks.mitigation: Manual registration remains available at all times; uptime and fallback exercised weekly.
